description: CC adapter (reference) vs the conformance reference producer conformance/producers/replay.py (candidate). Used by tools/shadow_diff/tests.py; also a worked example of an allowlist.

allow.reason: replay.py does not fill the optional tool_kind/command view (spec 4.3 SHOULD); the CC adapter does.
The CC adapter also emits producer.error for invalid replies and context-limit rejects (spec 9.1 SHOULD); replay.py only for its own faults.
For a TodoWrite PostToolUse the CC adapter emits tool.post and the synthesized plan.update (spec A.1); replay.py's plan-update step is the plan.update alone.
